Description:
Ballistics of the 105x617mm M456A2 HEAT-T-MP fired from the M68 tank gun.

Tube length is 5346mm, projectile travel 4750mm. Chamber volume is 6.14L. Loads 5.4kg of M30 grains with TiO2 wear reduction agent. Projectile weighs 10.43 kg. Develops 1133 m/s at 385 MPa.

References:
- STANAG 4458 105mm ammunition for rifled tank guns
- TM 43-0001-28 Army Ammunition Data Sheets for Artillery Ammunition: Guns, Howitzers, Mortars, Recoilless Rifles, Grenade Launchers and Artillery Fuzes
